observations: Large black multifunction printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub 223' are clearly printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine is shown from the front and slightly angled in photo 1.
The top glass surface and the automatic document feeder (ADF) are visible but obscured by plastic wrap.
No paper trays, control panel, or power cables are clearly visible in the provided shots.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The print heads or imaging units may be clogged or worn.
risks.proof: A clear photo of a freshly printed test page.

risks.risk: The paper trays may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer with all paper trays extended.

risks.risk: The toner may be empty or the drum may be near the end of its life.
risks.proof: A photo of the system status screen showing toner and drum levels.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the system status screen showing toner and drum levels.
Photo of the control panel and any cables.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen, even though the seller's functional claims are unverified.
